title: flourensia glutinosa
intro: Flourensia glutinosa, commonly known as Tarahumara tea or Resin daisy, is a plant species native to the Chihuahuan Desert in North America. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including colds, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of Flourensia glutinosa include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The health benefits of Tarahumara tea include reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues, and soothing coughs, making it a valuable natural remedy in traditional medicine.
